overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to review and approve the May draft of the City Council newsletter and coordinate tentative schedules for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: The committee approved the draft of the May newsletter summarizing council activities and budget adjustments, voting to keep the matter in committee.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Members discussed and coordinated tentative fall 2026 dates with school officials to host neighborhood ward meetings at local schools.
